customer_question: Before you finalize our registration Submission, will we get to review and confirm the content first, and can we request wording changes before it's submitted?
question_variants: Do we get to see the registration before it's finalized?
Will Submission only happen after we say it's OK?
Can we request text corrections to the Review Page before final Submission?
actual_issue: The customer needed assurance that the registration would not be finalized (Submitted) without their prior review and explicit approval, and that any requested corrections to the registration content would be applied before that final step.
plain_english_explanation: Before a Bluetooth registration is permanently submitted, the customer gets a chance to look at exactly what's about to be filed -- as an image of the final review screen -- and can ask for wording to be fixed. Only after the customer gives the go-ahead does the consultant actually click the button that locks in the registration.
consultant_answer: The consultant proceeds with the registration operation using the content from the registration confirmation document, then takes an image copy of the Review Page immediately before final registration confirmation and sends it to the customer by email for review. Final registration confirmation is only performed after receiving the customer's explicit instruction to proceed. When the customer subsequently requested specific wording corrections to the Review Page content, those corrections were applied before the final confirmation operation was performed.
decision_logic: Final Submission of a SIG registration should not be executed until the customer has reviewed an image of the pre-Submission Review Page and explicitly instructed the consultant to proceed, and any wording corrections the customer requests at that stage should be incorporated before Submission is finalized.
final_recommendation: Share a Review Page screenshot with the customer ahead of final Submission, apply any requested wording corrections, and only execute the final Submission action after receiving the customer's explicit confirmation.
risk_if_done_wrong: Finalizing Submission without customer review risks submitting incorrect content (such as wording the customer would have wanted corrected) to Bluetooth SIG, which is difficult or impossible to revise after the fact.
